specs.title: completes the multi-day stay and autonomous recovery journey
keeps the mobile Journey, Map, AI, Bookings, Me composition usable
an ACKNOWLEDGED disruption with no linked acceptance stays open: both '发生了什么' and '已知晓，仍待处理' render
an ACCEPTED proposal linked to the event by trigger_event_id closes it: no open/acknowledged notice, shown as handled
an ACCEPTED proposal with an UNRELATED trigger_event_id leaves the event open

suites.title: T3 ack vs resolution — Today surface (rendered integration)

specs.title: an ACKNOWLEDGED event with no acceptance stays an unresolved change on Today
a matching ACCEPTED replan clears the change count on Today
an UNRELATED accepted proposal still leaves the change unresolved on Today
acknowledged-only stays open; only linked acceptance resolves
NONE / PARTIAL / FULL are distinct, and only FULL allows a verdict
B4: all activities priced but an unknown hotel/booking stays PARTIAL (no trip verdict)
B4: all stops priced but an unknown stay/transport -> the block refuses a verified-budget verdict and shows PARTIAL wording
only when every budget-relevant item is known does the FULL verdict wording render
a KNOWN_FREE (0 amount) stop counts as known and keeps the block at FULL
